insights.headline: Ads opening with a transformation story earn more than average, yet get little budget.
insights.body: These 9 ads bring back ₹3.35 for every ₹1 spent, against ₹2.66 for your account overall. They get only 1% of your budget.
insights.action: Make 3 more ads that open with a personal transformation story, then move more budget behind them.

insights.headline: Ads opening with proof of results get clicks, but fewer add to cart.
insights.body: These 7 ads get 10% more people clicking through than average, but 19% fewer add to cart. So ₹5.4L of your budget sits on ads that lose more people before the cart than average.
insights.action: Test a clearer product page for these 7 ads, one that shows the benefit and price sooner, and keep the opening.

insights.headline: Grey-hair ads earn more on root touch-up powder, but hair colour gets the budget.
insights.body: On root touch-up powder, grey-hair ads bring back ₹3.14 for every ₹1 spent, but only ₹2.41 on hair colour. Hair colour gets about 6 times the budget, ₹4.1L against ₹65,141.
insights.action: Make more grey-hair ads for root touch-up powder, then move some hair colour budget to them.
insights.link_label: Opening hook: direct grey hair problem, root touch-up powder and hair colour

insights.headline: Night-time skincare ads with Shark Tank proof earn more than either idea alone.
insights.body: These 5 ads bring back ₹3.88 for every ₹1 spent, against ₹2.76 and ₹2.51 for each idea alone. So together they beat the stronger idea on its own by 41%.
insights.action: Make 3 more night-time skincare ads that also show the Shark Tank or TV endorsement.
insights.link_label: Pairing: night-time skincare use-case with Shark Tank / TV proof
